messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Senior staffing certification + budget handover for Q4 slate

Team —

Attached is the working workbook for the Q4 senior slate (VP+ and Director requests) and the companion comp-band proposal I received from Mercer. I pulled the items that require explicit leadership certification versus those we intend to route through the delegated hiring matrix. Key asks: please review and either (A) sign-off, (B) request a single-line change, or (C) flag for escalation by EOD Friday (2028-05-26).

Executive summary (high level):
- Net add: 8 senior slots (4 VP, 1 Sr Dir, 3 Director-level) — proposed by org leads to support 2029 roadmap.
- Priority ordering: Product (VP Applied ML), Infrastructure (Sr Dir Model Infra), Revenue Ops (VP GTM Ops), Security (Director).
- Budget impact: ~0.9 FTE run-rate increase vs baseline for FY29. Full breakdown in workbook.
- Comp bands: Mercer suggested slight upward adjustments in West Coast market for VP roles (attached PDF).

Approvals I'm requesting from you: 
1) Certification these roles are mission-critical and aligned with org priorities for Q4 intake.
2) Approval of the Mercer comp-band adjustments for market competitiveness (unless you object).
3) Permission to hand the workbook to Finance for DocuSign routing once we have consensus.

Attachments referenced: 2028_q4_executive_headcount_workbook.xlsx, comp-band-proposal-Q4.pdf

If helpful, I can schedule a short sync on Thursday morning for any contested items — otherwise I'll consolidate responses and send to Finance on Monday.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Director of Talent & Programs
Redwood Inference

--

Camila —

Thanks for the packet and the clear asks. Quick notes after a first pass: 
- VP Applied ML: full support in principle. One ask: can we include a 6-month milestone plan (hiring targets, early deliverables) in the workbook? That will help Product commit the hiring budget.
- Sr Dir Model Infra: curious why this is classified as Sr Dir vs Director (I think the role as written is more engineering-operational than strategic). Can Talent consider L6 vs L7 banding as an option?
- VP GTM Ops: Marcus and I are aligned; this role is revenue-accretive and I'm OK prioritizing.

On comp bands: Mercer note is sensible; I would rather we approve the modest uplift for VP roles but tighten bands for Directors by capping top end and adding stronger performance-based variable comp.

I'll reserve final sign-off pending Camila's updated workbook with the 6-month milestones and the L6/L7 alternative for Sr Dir.

- Aditya
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

All —

I support advancing the revenue-impacting roles (VP GTM Ops + VP Applied ML) as exceptions to the hiring guardrails. From a runway perspective we can free up two Director-level slots by pausing an open IC hiring plan in Sales Engineering; that offsets headcount and keeps the net run-rate in the margin we discussed with Finance last quarter.

Lauren — can you confirm Finance is comfortable with that swap and that we can route these two VP approvals through the expedited path? If Finance wants more detail I can provide the expected ARR impact and timeline (likely breakeven within 9 months).

Camila / Marcus / Aditya —

Thanks. Finance has a narrow tolerance for incremental run-rate increases this planning cycle but Marcus' suggested swap (pause two Sales Eng IC opens) is a reasonable offset. Conditional approvals from Finance:

- VP GTM Ops and VP Applied ML: approved provided Marcus' ARR case is included in the Finance cover memo.
- Sr Dir Model Infra: approve as L6 or L7 pending Talent recommendation; prefer the more conservative band if the role is implementation-heavy.
- Remaining Directors: approve only if we implement tighter cap + 10% variable comp as Aditya suggests.

Next steps for Camila: 
1) Update workbook with milestone plan for VP roles and the L6/L7 alternative for Sr Dir.
2) Team to finalize language for compensation variable component with Mercer.
3) Once updated, route to Finance for DocuSign. I'll circulate the final finance cover memo template later today.

Lauren Bishop
VP Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — consolidated update below. Appreciate the quick turn.

Summary of decisions (actioned):
- VP Applied ML: approved (conditional). Camila to add 6-month milestone plan to workbook.
- VP GTM Ops: approved (conditional on Marcus' ARR case in Finance memo).
- Sr Dir Model Infra: Talent to present L6 vs L7 job brief and recommended band; tentatively approve L6 if role remains implementation focused.
- Directors: approved with 10% variable comp cap on top-of-band as discussed.
- Swap: two Sales Eng IC openings to be paused to offset net run-rate — Marcus to confirm list of slots by EOD Tuesday (2028-05-30).

Next immediate actions (owners):
- Camila: update workbook, add VP milestones, attach Mercer comp-band redlines, create Finance cover memo draft, and kick DocuSign flow. (target: Wed 2028-05-31 morning)
- Marcus: list IC roles to pause and prepare ARR backing for VP GTM Ops (target: Tue 2028-05-30).
- Aditya: confirm performance-variable language and approve the Mercer adjustments (target: Tue 2028-05-30).
- Lauren / Finance: be ready to receive final workbook and route for DocuSign.

I'll incorporate these into the shared spreadsheet and loop in Sarah from Mercer and Emma from Greenlight for market checks and candidate pacing once we have the final doc.

Final note: I am creating the DocuSign envelope and will post the link in this thread when ready. If anyone wants a 15-minute sync on Wednesday to walk the final deck, say the word.

Thanks — Camila
Director of Talent & Programs
Redwood Inference
